description: This file defines a CachedContentRepository class that implements a cache-decorated content repository with SWR semantics. It manages cache logic, background refreshes, and cache busting for content data retrieval in a Flutter application.

classes.name: CachedContentRepository
classes.description: A repository implementing cache-first and SWR semantics for content, with cache busting and background refresh in a Flutter environment.

methods.name: _bustCache
methods.description: Increments the cache buster value to notify listeners of cache updates.

methods.name: _detailsKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for content details based on content ID.

methods.name: _searchKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for search results based on normalized query.

methods.name: _normalizeQuery
methods.description: Normalizes search queries to lowercase and trims whitespace for consistent caching.

methods.name: fetchHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches the home feed with cache-then-refresh or remote fallback.

methods.name: _refreshHomeFeed
methods.description: Background refresh of home feed cache.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves content item by ID with cache-then-refresh logic.

methods.name: _refreshDetails
methods.description: Background refresh for content details cache.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search with caching and background refresh.

methods.name: _refreshSearch
methods.description: Background refresh for search results cache.

methods.name: _decodeSearchResults
methods.description: Decodes cached JSON search results into a list of ContentItem.

methods.name: _encodeSearchResults
methods.description: Encodes a list of ContentItem into JSON for caching.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgress
methods.description: Records the playback position for given content ID into the database.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks playback as completed for a content ID (sets progress to zero).

methods.name: getPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves playback progress in seconds for a content ID.

methods.name: getRecentWatchHistory
methods.description: Retrieves recent watch history entries from the database.
